title: NFTs To The Future!
tagline: With NFTs to the Future, you can send encrypted NFT messages featuring AI-generated images that automatically decrypt after a set time.
description:
We’re developing NFTs to the FUTURE media service that lets you send your ideas or files into the future!

Just log in to the NFTs To The FUTURE website, write up an idea, and the service will encrypt it for a set period. This provides the basis for services where encrypted files need to be securely encrypted on the blockchain programmatically.

We're using LIT Protocol, which allows us to do encryptions or decryptions without requiring additional passwords or - in fact - any additional attention from the customer.
how_its_made:
We're still finalizing the design for this project. Initially we experimented with ICP, but we're now focused on implementing using LIT Protocol.

Integrating LIT Protocol into NFTs to the FUTURE should offer a reliable, decentralized solution for access control and encryption. LIT Protocol should ensure that the decryption of ideas remains secure and user-controlled, aligning with our vision of privacy and trust in idea sharing.
